senses.title: The preserved records: evidence kept on paper
senses.titleCN: 被保存的记录：留作证据的纸页
senses.definition: a collection of documents and records preserved because they serve as evidence of the past
senses.definitionCN: 因可作为过去之证据而被保存的文件与记录集合
senses.example: The archive contains every letter the company sent between 1900 and 1950.
senses.exampleCN: 这批档案包含了该公司 1900 至 1950 年间寄出的每一封信。
senses.why: Greek ta arkheia were public records kept by the city. The core image is a box of papers retained on purpose, so archive first names the records that are kept rather than thrown away.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 ta arkheia 是城邦保存的公共记录。核心意象是一只被有意留存而非丢弃的纸箱，因此 archive 首先指被保留下来的记录本身。

senses.title: The building: the place that holds the records
senses.titleCN: 建筑物：存放记录的场所
senses.definition: the room, building or institution where such records are stored and made available
senses.definitionCN: 存放这类记录并向人提供查阅的房间、建筑或机构
senses.example: The archive opens to researchers at nine in the morning.
senses.exampleCN: 档案馆上午九点向研究者开放。
senses.why: The container for the records is named by the same word: arkheion was a public building, and the English noun can shift from papers to the roof that shelters them.
senses.whyCN: 保存记录的容器用同一个词命名：arkheion 本就是公共建筑，英语名词因此可以从纸张滑向庇护它们的屋顶。

senses.title: The data store: digital retention
senses.titleCN: 数据仓库：数字留存
senses.definition: a store of digital material kept for future use, backup or research
senses.definitionCN: 为将来使用、备份或研究而保存的数字资料库
senses.example: The server keeps an archive of every image uploaded since 2010.
senses.exampleCN: 服务器保存着自 2010 年以来上传的每一张图片的存档。
senses.why: The evidence no longer has to be paper. A folder of old files performs the same act of retention, so archive transfers to digital storage without changing its purpose.
senses.whyCN: 证据不必再是纸。一个装旧文件的文件夹执行同样的留存动作，因此 archive 不改其目的就转移到数字存储。

senses.title: The body of work: an artist's or studio's past output
senses.titleCN: 作品全集：艺术家或机构的过往产出
senses.definition: the accumulated past works of a person or organisation, kept as a record of their development
senses.definitionCN: 个人或机构积累的过往作品，作为其发展过程的记录
senses.example: The fashion house's archive supplied the prints for the new collection.
senses.exampleCN: 这家时装屋的档案库为新系列提供了印花图样。
senses.why: A studio's papers and samples are evidence of its own past. The word extends from public records to any accumulated body of work that can be consulted later.
senses.whyCN: 工作室的纸稿与样品是它自身过去的证据。这个词从公共记录扩展到任何可供日后查阅的累积作品。

senses.title: The compressed bundle: a file archive
senses.titleCN: 压缩包：文件归档
senses.definition: in computing, a single file that bundles and often compresses many other files
senses.definitionCN: 在计算机领域，把许多文件打包、通常还压缩成的一个文件
senses.example: Download the .zip archive and unpack it into a new folder.
senses.exampleCN: 下载这个 .zip 压缩包，解压到一个新文件夹里。
senses.why: A physical archive box holds many papers in one container. The digital bundle reproduces that container, so the computing sense is a direct extension of 'many things kept together'.
senses.whyCN: 实体档案盒把许多纸张装进一个容器。数字压缩包复制了这个容器，因此计算机义是“许多东西被收在一起”的直接延伸。

senses.title: To file: enter a document into the collection
senses.titleCN: 归档：把文件纳入馆藏
senses.definition: to file or enter a document into an archive collection, recorded as a verb from 1819
senses.definitionCN: 把文件归入档案集合，动词义记录于 1819 年
senses.example: The clerk archived the deed in the county record office.
senses.exampleCN: 职员把这份契据归入县档案室。
senses.why: Once the noun named the collection, the act of putting something into it became a verb. The box closes and the paper joins the row, so 'archive' means 'place into the kept set'.
senses.whyCN: 一旦名词命名了集合，把东西放进集合的动作就变成动词。盒子合上，纸页加入那一排，于是 archive 表示“放入被保存的集合”。

senses.title: To move data aside: long-term storage
senses.titleCN: 移走数据：长期存储
senses.definition: to move digital material to a separate long-term store so that active systems stay uncluttered
senses.definitionCN: 把数字资料移到单独的长期存储中，使在用系统保持清爽
senses.example: The team archived last year's logs to free up the server.
senses.exampleCN: 团队把去年的日志存档，以腾出服务器空间。
senses.why: The verb keeps its filing meaning: material is moved from the active desk to the shelf. In computing the shelf is slower storage, but the action is still 'put away for later'.
senses.whyCN: 动词保留“归档”含义：材料从在用桌面移到架子上。在计算机里，架子是较慢的存储，但动作仍是“收起来备用”。

senses.title: To preserve for history: archive a website or a voice
senses.titleCN: 为历史保存：存档网站或口述
senses.definition: to capture and preserve something fragile or ephemeral so that later researchers can still consult it
senses.definitionCN: 抓取并保存易消失之物，使后来的研究者仍能查阅
senses.example: Librarians archived the protest website before it went offline.
senses.exampleCN: 抗议网站下线之前，图书馆员把它存档了。
senses.why: A website is a record that disappears when the server is switched off. Archiving it does what arkheia did for the city: it turns a live event into kept evidence.
senses.whyCN: 网站是记录，服务器一关就消失。给它存档，正是 arkheia 为城邦做过的事：把正在发生的事件变成被保存的证据。

senses.title: The personal store: memory as an archive
senses.titleCN: 个人储存：记忆作为档案
senses.definition: a figurative use for the accumulated store of memories, images or experiences that a person can draw on
senses.definitionCN: 比喻用法：一个人可调用的记忆、影像或经验的累积储存
senses.example: Her childhood photographs are the archive of a vanished street.
senses.exampleCN: 她童年的照片就是一条消失街道的档案。
senses.why: Memory retains selected traces and can be searched later, exactly like a box of papers. The word moves from institutional records to the private store of experience.
senses.whyCN: 记忆保留经过挑选的痕迹，日后可被检索，完全像一箱纸。这个词从机构记录转移到私人的经验储存。

senses.title: The back issue: a journal's published past
senses.titleCN: 过刊：期刊已出版的过去
senses.definition: the collected back numbers of a newspaper or journal, available for consultation
senses.definitionCN: 报纸或期刊已出版的过刊合集，可供查阅
senses.example: The magazine's archive is searchable back to its first issue.
senses.exampleCN: 这份杂志的过刊可检索到创刊号。
senses.why: Each issue is a dated record, and together they form a run. The publishing archive is another shelf of the same strongroom, organized by date rather than by author.
senses.whyCN: 每一期都是有日期的记录，合起来形成一个序列。出版档案是同一间库房里的另一排架子，按日期而非按作者排列。

intro.en: Archive is a back-formation from archives, which entered English about 1600 from French archif and late Latin archivum. The source is Greek ta arkheia 'public records', kept in the arkheion or town hall, from arkhē 'government, beginning'. Although archaeology also goes back to arkhē, archive is not derived from archaeology.
intro.cn: archive 是由 archives 逆构而来的；archives 约于 1600 年从法语 archif 和晚期拉丁语 archivum 进入英语。其源头是希腊语 ta arkheia“公共记录”，保存在 arkheion（市政厅）中，出自 arkhē“政府、开端”。虽然 archaeology 也可追到 arkhē，但 archive 并不是由 archaeology 派生出来的。

items.en: Archives is first recorded about 1600 as 'records or documents preserved as evidence'. The plural is the original English form.
items.cn: archives 约于 1600 年首次记录，义为“作为证据保存的记录或文件”。复数形式才是英语最初的形式。

items.en: From French archif (16c.), which passed on the Latin word for written records and their repository.
items.cn: 来自法语 archif（16 世纪），后者把拉丁语中“书面记录及其存放处”的词传了过来。

items.en: Late Latin archivum, plural archiva, meant both 'written records' and the place where they were kept.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 archivum（复数 archiva）既指“书面记录”，也指存放这些记录的场所。

items.en: The source is Greek ta arkheia 'public records', the plural of arkheion 'town hall, public building', from arkhē 'government', literally 'beginning, origin, first place'. Arkhē is the verbal noun of arkhein 'to be the first'.
items.cn: 源头是希腊语 ta arkheia“公共记录”，即 arkheion“市政厅、公共建筑”的复数，出自 arkhē“政府”，字面为“开端、起源、首位”。arkhē 是 arkhein“居于首位”的动名词。

items.en: The singular archive is a back-formation from archives, made by treating the plural -s as a plural ending. The exact date is not fixed in the standard references and is best left uncertain.
items.cn: 单数 archive 是从 archives 逆构出来的：把复数的 -s 当成了复数词尾。通行资料未给出确切年代，此处如实存疑。

items.en: The verb is recorded in 1819 as 'to file or enter into an archive collection'. Digital and web senses follow in the late 20c.
items.cn: 动词义记录于 1819 年，意为“归档、纳入档案集合”。数字与网络义在 20 世纪晚期出现。

note.en: The first group separates the plural source and close derivatives from a false friend; the second separates places and things that store records.
note.cn: 第一组区分复数来源、近亲派生词与一个假朋友；第二组区分存放记录的场所与物件。

entries.definition: The original plural, meaning records or the institution that holds them. The singular archive was back-formed from it.
entries.definitionCN: 最初的复数形式，指档案或保管档案的机构。单数 archive 正是由它逆构而来。

entries.definition: A person who appraises, arranges and preserves archives. It is archive + -ist, not a separate root.
entries.definitionCN: 负责鉴定、整理和保存档案的人。它是 archive + -ist，并非另一词根。

entries.definition: A curved structural opening, from Latin arcus 'bow'. It looks like the first syllable of archive but is unrelated.
entries.definitionCN: 拱形结构开口，来自拉丁语 arcus“弓”。它看起来像 archive 的第一音节，但并无词源关系。

entries.definition: A place where things are stored, especially records or objects. It stresses the container more than the historical evidence.
entries.definitionCN: 存放物品（尤指记录或器物）的场所。它比 archive 更强调容器，而非历史证据。

entries.definition: A single piece of written evidence. An archive is the organised collection of many records.
entries.definitionCN: 单份书面证据。archive 是许多 records 的有组织集合。

entries.definition: A secure room for valuables or records. It stresses protection from theft or damage, not public access.
entries.definitionCN: 存放贵重物品或记录的安全房间。它强调防盗防损，而非公共查阅。

normalIntro.en: The links are real: the Greek public records arkheia, the plural archives from which the singular was back-formed, and the 1819 verb.
normalIntro.cn: 这些联想是真实的：希腊语公共记录 arkheia、逆构出单数的复数 archives，以及 1819 年的动词。

normal.en: Think of the plural first: archives are the records, and archive is the single collection or the act of filing.
normal.cn: 先记复数：archives 是记录，archive 是单数的集合或归档动作。

normal.en: Greek ta arkheia were public records kept in the town hall; the building and the papers share one name.
normal.cn: 希腊语 ta arkheia 是保存在市政厅的公共记录；建筑与纸张共用一个名称。

normal.en: A .zip archive is the digital version of a box: many files packed into one container.
normal.cn: zip 压缩包是盒子的数字版：许多文件被装进一个容器。

normal.en: The verb is 'put it in the box': archive a letter, archive a website, archive last year's logs.
normal.cn: 动词就是“放进盒子”：把信归档、把网站存档、把去年的日志归档。

normal.en: Do not confuse it with archaeology: archive goes back to arkhē 'government', not to arkhaios 'ancient'.
normal.cn: 别与 archaeology 混淆：archive 追到 arkhē“政府”，不是 arkhaios“古老”。

abstract.en: Picture a strongroom: the door closes, the date label is written, and a moment of the past is made reachable.
abstract.cn: 想象一间档案库：门关上，年份标签写好，过去的一刻变得可被触及。

abstract.en: The same act works on paper, film, code or memory: select, keep, label, and make searchable.
abstract.cn: 同一个动作作用于纸、胶片、代码或记忆：挑选、保留、贴标、使其可检索。

abstract.en: An archive is a promise that the future will still be able to ask questions of the past.
abstract.cn: 档案是一个承诺：未来仍然能够向过去提问。

examples.en: The letters lay in the archive for ninety years before anyone read them.
examples.cn: 这些信在档案馆里放了九十年，才有人读到。

examples.en: Please archive the signed contract under the client's name.
examples.cn: 请把签好的合同按客户姓名归档。

examples.en: The web archive kept a copy of the page after the site closed.
examples.cn: 网站关闭后，网络存档保留了这个页面的副本。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿凯伍」——阿凯把五箱旧文件搬进库房，贴上标签锁好门 → archive 档案；归档

root: 由 archives 逆构而来；archives 约 1600 年借自法语 archif，源头为晚期拉丁 archivum 与希腊 ta arkheia“公共记录”（arkheion“市政厅”，出自 arkhē“政府、开端”）。

sensesIntro.en: Ten senses of archive all perform one act: select something, keep it, and make it consultable later. From papers and the building that holds them, the word extends to data, a body of work, a zip file, the act of filing, long-term storage, web preservation, memory, and back issues.
sensesIntro.cn: archive 的十个义项都在执行同一个动作：挑选某物、保存它、让日后可查阅。从纸张与保管它们的建筑，这个词扩展到数据、作品全集、压缩包、归档动作、长期存储、网络保存、记忆与过刊。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a labelled box of papers kept on purpose in a locked room.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只贴好标签的纸箱，被有意保存在上锁的房间里。

branches.en: PAPERS AND PLACE: the records and the building share one word, as arkheia and arkheion did.
branches.cn: 纸张与场所：记录与建筑共用一个词，正如 arkheia 与 arkheion。

branches.en: DIGITAL CONTAINERS: a data store and a zip bundle reproduce the box in another medium.
branches.cn: 数字容器：数据仓库与压缩包以另一种介质复制了这只盒子。

branches.en: ACCUMULATED OUTPUT: a studio's works and a journal's back issues are runs of dated records.
branches.cn: 累积产出：工作室作品与期刊过刊，都是按日期排列的记录序列。

branches.en: THE VERB: filing a document and moving data aside are the same 'put it away'.
branches.cn: 动词：归档文件与移走数据，都是同一个“收起来”。

branches.en: PRESERVING THE FLEETING: a website and a memory are saved so later questions can still be asked.
branches.cn: 保存易逝之物：网站与记忆被存下，使日后的提问仍能成立。

intro.en: Archive has no living prefix or suffix of its own: the word came whole from Latin archivum and Greek arkheion. English then built archival, archivist, archivable and archivism on the noun, and the plural archives is the historical source.
intro.cn: archive 本身没有活的英语前缀或后缀：它是从拉丁语 archivum 和希腊语 arkheion 整体借来的。英语随后在这个名词上构造出 archival、archivist、archivable 与 archivism，而复数 archives 是它的历史来源。

latinIntro.en: Late Latin archivum and its plural archiva meant written records and their repository. Greek arkheion 'town hall' and arkheia 'public records' are the deeper source, from arkhē 'government, beginning'.
latinIntro.cn: 晚期拉丁语 archivum 及其复数 archiva 指书面记录及其存放处。更深的源头是希腊语 arkheion“市政厅”与 arkheia“公共记录”，出自 arkhē“政府、开端”。

items.meaning: records preserved as evidence, or the institution holding them
items.meaningCN: 作为证据保存的档案，或保管它们的机构（-es 为复数词尾）
items.example: The city's archives go back to the twelfth century.
items.exampleCN: 这座城市的档案可追溯到 12 世纪。

items.meaning: a collection of records, or to file into one
items.meaningCN: 档案集合；归档（由复数逆构出的单数）
items.example: The archive fills three rooms.
items.exampleCN: 这批档案装满了三个房间。

items.meaning: relating to archives or suitable for long preservation
items.meaningCN: 档案的；适合长期保存的（-al 构成形容词）
items.example: Store the negatives in archival sleeves.
items.exampleCN: 把底片存放在档案级保护套里。

items.meaning: a person who appraises and preserves archives
items.meaningCN: 档案管理员；档案学者（-ist 表示从业者）
items.example: The archivist refused to separate the two collections.
items.exampleCN: 档案管理员拒绝把这两批馆藏分开。

items.meaning: suitable or able to be archived
items.meaningCN: 可归档的；适合存档的（-able 表示能够）
items.example: Only the final drafts are archivable.
items.exampleCN: 只有定稿适合存档。

items.meaning: in archival terms or by archival methods
items.meaningCN: 在档案方面；以档案方式（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: The papers were archivally boxed in acid-free card.
items.exampleCN: 这些文件用无酸纸盒按档案标准装好。

items.meaning: an orientation or practice centred on archiving
items.meaningCN: 档案主义；以存档为中心的做法（-ism 构成体系名词）
items.example: The artist's archivism turned every receipt into a work.
items.exampleCN: 这位艺术家的档案主义把每张收据都变成了作品。

items.meaning: the ongoing act or process of archiving
items.meaningCN: 归档工作；存档过程（-ing 构成过程名词）
items.example: Archiving the paper's website took three years.
items.exampleCN: 给这家报纸的网站存档花了三年。

items.meaning: filed away, or stored and no longer active
items.meaningCN: 已归档的；已存档、不再活跃的（-ed 构成分词或形容词）
items.example: The archived thread can still be searched.
items.exampleCN: 已存档的帖子仍然可以搜索。

items.meaning: the process of making something archival or of turning it into an archive
items.meaningCN: 档案化；使某物成为档案的过程（-ization 构成过程名词）
items.example: The archivization of everyday life is a modern habit.
items.exampleCN: 把日常生活档案化是一种现代习惯。

latinEntries.meaning: written records; the place where they are kept
latinEntries.meaningCN: 晚期拉丁语名词，复数 archiva：书面记录；存放处
晚期拉丁语复数：一批批书面记录
希腊语名词：市政厅、公共建筑
希腊语复数名词：公共记录

latinEntries.meaning: government, rule; literally beginning or first place
latinEntries.meaningCN: 希腊语名词：政府、统治；字面为开端或首位

definition_zh: 档案的；档案保存的；取自档案的；适合长期存档的
definition_en: relating to archives, contained in or drawn from historical records, or suitable for long-term preservation
core_image: 阅览室里，一双白手套翻开一只无酸纸档案盒
scene: In a quiet reading room, gloved hands open an acid-free box of letters beside a microfilm scanner and a pencil-only notebook. The gloves and the acid-free box are standard archival practice.
sceneCN: 这里 archival 是「与档案有关的」（第 1 个义项：档案的）；句意：白手套与无酸档案盒是标准的档案保护做法。图中可辨识物件：白手套、无酸档案盒、信札、缩微胶片扫描仪、铅笔、阅览桌。

collocations.zh: 档案级质量；适合长期保存的品质

senses.title: Relating to archives: the general adjective
senses.titleCN: 与档案有关：一般形容词义
senses.definition: relating to archives, their organisation, or the work of keeping records, recorded from 1800
senses.definitionCN: 与档案、档案整理或记录保存工作有关，此义记录于 1800 年
senses.example: The project's archival work took longer than its fieldwork.
senses.exampleCN: 这个项目的档案工作比田野工作花的时间还长。
senses.why: Archival is archives + -al, and archives are kept records. The suffix simply means 'pertaining to', so the adjective covers everything that belongs to the archive as an institution.
senses.whyCN: archival 是 archives + -al，而 archives 是被保存的记录。后缀只表示“与……有关”，因此这个形容词覆盖属于档案馆这一机构的一切。

senses.title: Contained in records: archival evidence
senses.titleCN: 存于记录中：档案证据
senses.definition: contained in or drawn from public records and historical documents rather than from fieldwork or oral report
senses.definitionCN: 存于或取自公共记录与历史文件，而非来自田野调查或口述
senses.example: The claim rests on archival evidence, not on the memoir.
senses.exampleCN: 这一主张依据的是档案证据，而不是回忆录。
senses.why: The 1800 sense was 'pertaining to or contained in public records'. Evidence that sits inside a box is archival, and the word marks its source rather than its subject.
senses.whyCN: 1800 年的义项是“与公共记录有关或存于其中的”。放在盒子里的证据就是 archival，这个词标记的是证据来源，而不是主题。

senses.title: Fit for keeping: archival quality
senses.titleCN: 适合保存：档案级品质
senses.definition: made of materials and by methods that will not damage documents over long storage
senses.definitionCN: 使用在长期保存中不会损伤文件的材料与方法
senses.example: Use archival paper for the originals, not ordinary copy paper.
senses.exampleCN: 原件要用档案级纸张，不要用普通复印纸。
senses.why: If an archive is a place of long keeping, then anything that supports long keeping can be called archival. The adjective moves from the institution to the standard of preservation it requires.
senses.whyCN: 如果档案馆是一个长期保存的场所，那么任何支持长期保存的东西都可称为 archival。形容词从机构转移到机构所要求的保存标准。

senses.title: Historical rather than current: archival footage
senses.titleCN: 历史的而非当下的：档案影像
senses.definition: of film, photographs or sound, taken from a store of past material and used as historical illustration
senses.definitionCN: 指影片、照片或声音取自过去材料的储存，用作历史说明
senses.example: The documentary opens with archival footage of the old harbour.
senses.exampleCN: 这部纪录片以旧港口的档案影像开场。
senses.why: Material taken out of the archive is by definition older than the programme using it. Archival therefore signals 'from the store of the past', often in contrast to footage shot today.
senses.whyCN: 从档案中取出的材料，按定义就比使用它的节目更旧。因此 archival 表示“取自过去储存”，常与今天拍摄的影像相对。

senses.title: Records management: no longer active, kept forever
senses.titleCN: 记录管理：不再活跃、永久保存
senses.definition: of records that are no longer needed for current business but are kept permanently for legal or historical value
senses.definitionCN: 指当前业务已不再需要、但因法律或历史价值而永久保存的记录
senses.example: The files become archival five years after the account closes.
senses.exampleCN: 账户结清五年后，这些文件就转为档案保存。
senses.why: In records management a document moves through stages: active, semi-current, then archival. The adjective marks the final stage, when the file stops circulating and becomes evidence.
senses.whyCN: 在记录管理中，文件经历阶段：活跃、半现行，然后档案化。这个形容词标记最后阶段：文件停止流转，成为证据。

senses.title: A method: archival research
senses.titleCN: 一种方法：档案研究
senses.definition: of research, based primarily on documents and records held in archives
senses.definitionCN: 指主要依据档案馆所藏文件与记录的研究
senses.example: Her archival research traced the firm through tax registers.
senses.exampleCN: 她的档案研究通过税务登记册追踪了这家公司。
senses.why: When a historian works from boxes rather than from interviews or digs, the method itself is named by its source. Archival research is research whose evidence lives in an archive.
senses.whyCN: 当历史学者依据档案盒而不是访谈或发掘工作时，方法本身就以来源命名。archival research 就是证据住在档案馆里的研究。

senses.title: Computing: storage for the long term
senses.titleCN: 计算机：长期存储
senses.definition: of data storage designed for long retention rather than frequent access
senses.definitionCN: 指为长期保留而非频繁访问而设计的数据存储
senses.example: The tapes are kept in archival storage in a different building.
senses.exampleCN: 这些磁带存放在另一栋建筑里的长期档案存储中。
senses.why: Digital keeping repeats the archive's promise. Archival storage is slower and cheaper because its purpose is survival, not daily use, exactly like a strongroom.
senses.whyCN: 数字保存重复了档案馆的承诺。档案存储更慢、更便宜，因为它的目的是存活，而不是日常使用，完全像一间档案库。

senses.title: Held but not displayed: an archival collection
senses.titleCN: 收藏但不展出：档案收藏
senses.definition: of objects or papers kept in a museum's or library's collection for study rather than for permanent display
senses.definitionCN: 指博物馆或图书馆为研究而非长期展出而收藏的物件或纸稿
senses.example: The dress is archival, so it is shown in a case for only six weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 这条裙子属于档案收藏，因此只在展柜里展出六周。
senses.why: An archive keeps things for consultation, not for the wall. Archival therefore marks the status of an object that is preserved and available but not on permanent show.
senses.whyCN: 档案馆为查阅而保存，不为挂墙而保存。因此 archival 标记一种状态：被保存、可查阅，但不长期展出。

senses.title: The discipline: archival science
senses.titleCN: 学科：档案学
senses.definition: relating to the professional theory and practice of appraising, arranging and preserving records
senses.definitionCN: 与鉴定、整理和保存记录的专业理论与实践有关
senses.example: Archival science decides which records deserve permanent preservation.
senses.exampleCN: 档案学决定哪些记录值得永久保存。
senses.why: Once keeping records becomes a profession with rules, the adjective names its field. Archival science is the theory of what the archive does, not the archive itself.
senses.whyCN: 一旦保存记录成为有规则的专业，形容词就命名其领域。archival science 是研究档案馆做什么的理论，而不是档案馆本身。

senses.title: Archival silence: what the record never says
senses.titleCN: 档案的沉默：记录从未说出的事
senses.definition: relating to the gaps and absences in a record system, especially the voices that were never documented
senses.definitionCN: 与记录系统中的空白与缺失有关，尤指从未被记录的群体声音
senses.example: The archival silence around the servants is louder than the letters themselves.
senses.exampleCN: 围绕仆人们的档案沉默，比那些信件本身更响。
senses.why: An archive is a selection, and every selection leaves something out. The adjective turns to the missing side: what the boxes do not contain is still a property of the archive.
senses.whyCN: 档案馆是一次挑选，而每次挑选都会漏掉一些东西。形容词转向缺失的一面：盒子里没有的东西，仍然是档案的一种属性。

intro.en: Archival is archives + -al, first recorded in 1800. It is an adjective built on the plural noun, not a participle of the verb archive. Its -al is the Latin -alis, the same suffix as in architectural, but the base is different: archives, not architecture.
intro.cn: archival 是 archives + -al，首次记录于 1800 年。它是建立在复数名词上的形容词，不是动词 archive 的分词。它的 -al 是拉丁语 -alis，与 architectural 中的后缀相同，但词基不同：是 archives，不是 architecture。

items.en: First recorded in 1800 as 'pertaining to or contained in public records'.
items.cn: 最早记录于 1800 年，义为“与公共记录有关或存于其中的”。

items.en: The base archives enters English about 1600, meaning records preserved as evidence.
items.cn: 词基 archives 约于 1600 年进入英语，意为作为证据保存的记录。

items.en: The -al is Latin -alis, an adjective-forming suffix meaning 'pertaining to'. English attaches it to nouns, here to the plural archives.
items.cn: -al 是拉丁语 -alis，构成形容词、表示“与……有关的”后缀。英语把它加在名词上，这里加在复数 archives 上。

items.en: Archives goes back to late Latin archivum, plural archiva, 'written records' and their repository.
items.cn: archives 可追到晚期拉丁语 archivum（复数 archiva），意为“书面记录”及其存放处。

items.en: The deeper source is Greek ta arkheia 'public records' and arkheion 'town hall', from arkhē 'government, beginning'.
items.cn: 更深的源头是希腊语 ta arkheia“公共记录”与 arkheion“市政厅”，出自 arkhē“政府、开端”。

items.en: In the 20c archival extends to preservation standards, media footage, museum storage and computing, while archival science names the profession's theory.
items.cn: 20 世纪 archival 扩展到保存标准、媒体影像、博物馆藏品与计算机领域，archival science 则命名这一专业的理论。

note.en: The first group shares the -al ending or the archiv- stem but differs in base; the second shares the idea of historical evidence or preservation.
note.cn: 第一组共享 -al 词尾或 archiv- 词干，但词基不同；第二组共享“历史证据或保存”的观念。

entries.definition: Suitable to be archived. It is archive + -able, a capability adjective, while archival describes what belongs to archives.
entries.definitionCN: 可归档的。它是 archive + -able，表能力，而 archival 描述属于档案的事物。

entries.definition: Relating to archaeology. It shares the -ical ending and the arch- look but comes from arkhaios 'ancient'.
entries.definitionCN: 与考古学有关的。它共享 -ical 词尾和 arch- 外形，但来自 arkhaios“古老”。

entries.definition: Relating to architecture. It uses the same Latin -alis, but the base is architecture, not archives.
entries.definitionCN: 与建筑有关的。它使用同一个拉丁 -alis，但词基是 architecture，不是 archives。

entries.definition: Relating to history or to the past. Archival specifically marks material kept in records, not anything old.
entries.definitionCN: 与历史或过去有关。archival 特指保存在记录中的材料，而不是任何旧东西。

entries.definition: Based on or consisting of documents. It names the kind of evidence, while archival names where that evidence is kept.
entries.definitionCN: 以文件为依据或由文件构成的。它命名证据种类，而 archival 命名证据存放之处。

entries.definition: Kept intact over time. It describes the result of protection, while archival describes the standard or origin of that protection.
entries.definitionCN: 随时间保持完好。它描述保护的结果，而 archival 描述这种保护的标准或来源。

normalIntro.en: The links are real: archives + -al in 1800, the Latin -alis suffix, and the deliberate contrast with architectural and archaeological.
normalIntro.cn: 这些联想是真实的：1800 年的 archives + -al、拉丁 -alis 后缀，以及与 architectural、archaeological 的刻意对照。

normal.en: archives + -al: first the boxes, then the adjective for everything that belongs to them.
normal.cn: archives + -al：先是档案盒，再是由此构成的、属于档案的一切的形容词。

normal.en: It is not the participle of the verb archive: 'archived' means filed away, 'archival' means of or for archives.
normal.cn: 它不是动词 archive 的分词：archived 是“已归档”，archival 是“档案的、供档案用的”。

normal.en: Same -al as architectural, different base: architecture is buildings, archives are records.
normal.cn: 与 architectural 同一个 -al，但词基不同：architecture 是建筑，archives 是记录。

normal.en: The four common frames are archival research, material, footage and quality.
normal.cn: 四个常见搭配是 archival research、material、footage 与 quality。

normal.en: White gloves and acid-free boxes are the practical meaning of archival quality.
normal.cn: 白手套与无酸纸盒，就是 archival quality 的实际含义。

abstract.en: Think of a sealed box that outlives the hand that wrote the letter: archival is the adjective of that survival.
abstract.cn: 想象一只封好的盒子，比写信的那只手活得更久：archival 就是这种“存活”的形容词。

abstract.en: The archive is a bridge: the adjective describes both what crosses it and the strength of its cables.
abstract.cn: 档案馆是一座桥：这个形容词既描述过桥之物，也描述桥索的强度。

abstract.en: Anything archival has been chosen twice: once to be kept, and again to be trusted.
abstract.cn: 任何 archival 之物都被挑选过两次：一次是被留下，一次是被信任。

examples.en: The historian spent a year in archival research before writing a single chapter.
examples.cn: 这位历史学家做了一年档案研究，才动笔写第一章。

examples.en: The film uses archival footage of the city before the war.
examples.cn: 这部影片使用了战前该城的档案影像。

examples.en: Print the originals on archival paper so they survive another century.
examples.cn: 把原件印在档案级纸张上，好让它们再保存一个世纪。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿凯沃」——阿凯把旧信放进无酸盒，沃（护）住纸页不让它发黄 → archival 档案的、适合存档的

root: 由 archives + -al（拉丁 -alis）构成，1800 年首次记录；archives 出自晚期拉丁 archivum，再往前是希腊 arkheion“市政厅”与 ta arkheia“公共记录”，源于 arkhē“政府、开端”。

sensesIntro.en: Ten senses of archival all concern kept records: the institution, the evidence drawn from it, the standard that keeps it, historical footage, the final stage of a file, a research method, long-term data storage, museum storage, the discipline itself, and the silence of those left out.
sensesIntro.cn: archival 的十个义项都围绕“被保存的记录”：机构、取自其中的证据、使其长存的保存标准、历史影像、文件的最后阶段、研究方法、长期数据存储、博物馆藏品、这门学科本身，以及被遗漏者的沉默。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: gloved hands opening an acid-free box of letters in a quiet reading room.
core.cn: 核心意象：安静阅览室里，一双戴手套的手打开一只无酸信札盒。

branches.en: THE INSTITUTION AND ITS EVIDENCE: what belongs to archives, and what is contained in them.
branches.cn: 机构与证据：属于档案馆的事物，以及存于其中的事物。

branches.en: THE STANDARD OF KEEPING: archival quality and the final, inactive stage of a record.
branches.cn: 保存标准：档案级品质，以及记录不再活跃的最后阶段。

branches.en: THE STATUS OF THE OBJECT: footage from the past, and museum pieces held but not displayed.
branches.cn: 物件状态：取自过去的影像，以及收藏但不展出的博物馆藏品。

branches.en: THE METHOD AND THE FIELD: research based on boxes, and the professional theory of keeping.
branches.cn: 方法与领域：基于档案盒的研究，以及保存记录的专业理论。

branches.en: WHAT IS KEPT AND WHAT IS MISSING: digital storage extends the strongroom, while archival silence marks what the strongroom never held.
branches.cn: 保存了什么与缺失了什么：数字存储延伸了档案库，而档案沉默标记档案库从未收进的东西。

intro.en: Archival is archives + -al, with the Latin adjective suffix -alis. It is not the participle of the verb archive; that would be archived. English later built archivally, archivable, archivism and archivization on the same base.
intro.cn: archival 是 archives + -al，带拉丁形容词后缀 -alis。它不是动词 archive 的分词（那会是 archived）。英语后来又在这个词基上构造出 archivally、archivable、archivism 与 archivization。

latinIntro.en: The base archives comes from late Latin archiva, plural of archivum, from Greek ta arkheia 'public records' kept in the arkheion. The suffix -alis is the ordinary Latin adjective ending that also produced architectural and archaeological.
latinIntro.cn: 词基 archives 来自晚期拉丁语 archiva（archivum 的复数），再往前是保存在 arkheion 中的希腊语 ta arkheia“公共记录”。后缀 -alis 是普通的拉丁形容词词尾，也造就了 architectural 与 archaeological。

items.meaning: relating to archives, or suitable for long preservation
items.meaningCN: 档案的；适合长期保存的（-al 构成形容词）
items.example: The letters are now in archival storage.
items.exampleCN: 这些信件现在存于档案库中。

items.meaning: in archival terms; by archival standards
items.meaningCN: 在档案方面；按档案标准（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: The photographs were archivally processed.
items.exampleCN: 这些照片按档案标准处理过。

items.meaning: a collection of records, or to file into one
items.meaningCN: 档案；归档（由复数逆构的单数）
items.example: They decided to archive the whole correspondence.
items.exampleCN: 他们决定把这批通信全部归档。

items.meaning: records preserved as evidence
items.meaningCN: 作为证据保存的档案（复数）
items.example: The national archives hold the census returns.
items.exampleCN: 国家档案馆藏有人口普查表。

items.meaning: a person who preserves and arranges archives
items.meaningCN: 档案管理员（-ist 表示从业者）
items.example: The archivist checked the box against the catalogue.
items.exampleCN: 档案管理员对照目录核对了这只盒子。

items.meaning: suitable to be archived
items.meaningCN: 可归档的；适合存档的（-able 表示能够）
items.example: The drafts are not archivable without dates.
items.exampleCN: 没有日期，这些草稿不适合存档。

items.meaning: a practice or outlook centred on archiving
items.meaningCN: 档案主义；以存档为中心的做法（-ism 构成体系名词）
items.example: The exhibition reflects the archivism of the digital age.
items.exampleCN: 这场展览反映了数字时代的档案主义。

items.meaning: the process of filing or preserving material
items.meaningCN: 归档；存档过程（-ing 构成过程名词）
items.example: Archiving the letters took two summers.
items.exampleCN: 给这些信件存档花了两个夏天。

items.meaning: the act of turning something into an archive
items.meaningCN: 档案化；使某物成为档案（-ization 构成过程名词）
items.example: The archivization of the studio began after the artist died.
items.exampleCN: 艺术家去世后，工作室的档案化工作才开始。

晚期拉丁语复数：一批批记录
希腊语名词：市政厅、公共建筑
希腊语名词：政府；开端、首位
